name: event-call-intro
objective: Introduce Event by InSync to a potential B2B client and qualify their interest in streamlining their corporate event management processes.
opening: Hi [Name], this is [Your Name] calling from InSync — I hope I'm catching you at a good time. I'm reaching out because we've been helping companies like yours simplify and automate their end-to-end event management, and I wanted to take just a few minutes to share how our platform, Event, might be a good fit for your team. Would you be open to a quick two-minute overview?
key_points: Event is an all-in-one B2B SaaS platform designed to help organizations plan, manage, and execute corporate events — from registrations and agendas to attendee engagement and post-event analytics — all in one place.
Our platform eliminates the chaos of juggling multiple tools by centralizing event workflows, reducing manual effort, and giving your team real-time visibility into every aspect of your events.

Event is built for scalability, whether you're running a small internal team meeting or a large multi-day conference with thousands of attendees, the platform adapts to your needs without additional complexity.
We offer seamless integrations with popular CRM, marketing, and communication tools, so your existing tech stack works smarter alongside Event rather than being replaced.
Companies using Event have reported significant reductions in event planning time and improved attendee satisfaction scores, directly contributing to stronger ROI on their event investments.

objection_handling.We don't have the budget for a new platf: I completely understand — budget is always a key consideration. What I'd suggest is that we at least have a short discovery call to understand your current event costs and workflows. Many of our clients found that Event actually reduced their overall event spend by consolidating tools and cutting manual hours. If the numbers don't make sense for you, we'll be upfront about that. Would a no-obligation conversation be worth 20 minutes of your time?
objection_handling.We don't run enough events to justify a: That's a fair point, and it's something we hear often. The interesting thing is that even teams running just a handful of events per year find significant value in Event because of the time saved on coordination, follow-ups, and reporting. Plus, as your business grows, having a scalable system already in place means you're never scrambling. Could I ask roughly how many events your team manages in a year, just so I can give you a more relevant picture?
objection_handling.We already have a process/tool in place: That's great to hear — most of our clients actually came to us with existing tools or processes. What we typically find is that Event doesn't replace everything overnight; instead, it fills the gaps where those tools fall short, like real-time reporting or attendee engagement. Would you be open to a quick demo just to see if there's any area where we could add value on top of what you already have?

closing: I really appreciate you taking the time to chat today, [Name] — based on what you've shared, I think there's a strong case for exploring how Event could support your team's goals. Can we schedule a 20-minute demo this week or next so you can see the platform in action and ask any questions you might have? I'll send over a calendar invite along with a quick overview of Event so you have everything you need before we connect.

name: event-call-follow-up
objective: Re-engage the prospect after an initial demo or outreach to address any outstanding concerns, reinforce the value of Event, and move them closer to a purchasing decision.
opening: Hi [Prospect Name], this is [Your Name] from In-Sync, hope you're doing well! I'm reaching out to follow up on our recent conversation about Event, our end-to-end event management platform. I wanted to check in, see if you had any questions after the demo, and explore how Event can specifically support your upcoming events.
key_points: Event streamlines the entire event lifecycle — from registration and ticketing to attendee engagement and post-event analytics — all within a single unified platform, eliminating the need for multiple disconnected tools.

Our platform is built for B2B teams and scales effortlessly whether you're running small internal workshops or large multi-track conferences, giving your team full control without the operational overhead.
Event provides real-time dashboards and detailed reporting so you can measure ROI, track attendance trends, and make data-driven decisions that improve every future event.
We offer seamless integrations with popular CRMs, marketing automation tools, and communication platforms, ensuring Event fits naturally into your existing tech stack with minimal disruption.
Our dedicated onboarding and customer success team ensures your team is up and running quickly, with ongoing support to maximize the value you get from the platform from day one.

objection_handling.We need more time to evaluate: Absolutely, taking the time to make the right decision is important, and I respect that. To help make your evaluation easier, I can put together a tailored proposal, share relevant case studies from companies similar to yours, and even arrange a pilot or trial period so your team can experience Event firsthand before committing. Would that kind of support help speed up your internal review?
objection_handling.We don't have the budget right now: I completely hear you, and budget timing is always a real consideration. What I'd suggest is that we map out the cost of your current event operations — including staff time, multiple tool subscriptions, and any revenue lost from poor attendee experiences — and compare that against what Event would cost. Many of our clients find the platform pays for itself within the first two or three events. Can we set aside 20 minutes to walk through that together?
objection_handling.We already have a tool we use for events: That's completely understandable, and many of our current customers came from using a mix of tools or a legacy platform. What we often hear is that those solutions either lack deep analytics, don't scale well, or require too much manual effort. I'd love to understand what your current setup looks like and show you specifically where Event can fill those gaps or consolidate your workflow — would you be open to a quick comparison?

closing: I really appreciate you taking the time to reconnect today, [Prospect Name] — it's clear that managing events effectively is a priority for your team, and I'm confident Event can make a real difference. As a next step, I'd love to schedule a focused session with your key stakeholders to address any remaining questions and walk through a customized plan for your use case. Can we find a time this week or next that works for you?

name: event-call-demo
objective: Demonstrate how Event by InSync streamlines end-to-end event management for B2B teams and secure a follow-up commitment or trial sign-up.

key_points: Event provides a centralized dashboard to plan, manage, and track all your corporate events in one place — from budgeting and vendor coordination to attendee management and post-event analytics.
Our platform supports real-time collaboration, allowing multiple team members and external vendors to work simultaneously without version conflicts or miscommunication.
Event integrates seamlessly with tools your team already uses, including CRMs, calendar platforms, and communication tools, reducing manual data entry and saving hours of administrative work.

Event is priced to deliver ROI quickly, and we do offer flexible plans. Can I share a quick breakdown of how similar-sized teams have justified the investment?

name: event-call-closing
objective: Secure a signed commitment from the prospect to move forward with Event as their B2B event management platform by addressing final concerns and confirming next steps.
opening: Hi [Name], thanks for taking the time to connect today — I know your schedule is packed. Based on our previous conversations and the demo walkthrough, I wanted to touch base and see if you're ready to move forward with Event so we can get your team set up before your next big event.
